title: NDVI over the foundry Landsat scene — the documented lab-1 student flow (generate samples -> rs:spectral_index -> grade)

assertions.derivation: Foundry grid contract (docs/adr/0164): sicnu_generate_samples (tools/sample_foundry) emits the Lab profile as 256x256 at 30 m in EPSG:32648 (UTM 48N); a submission on another grid is not comparable to the known answer. Same pins as the offline-classroom bundle overlay (packaging/bundle/labs/grading-overlay/ndvi_basics.rules.json) — this file is the repo-side copy of that foundry-scene authority — the piece R21-E CT-6 showed missing on the repo side. Switching scripts/windows/run_lab.cmd (and only that one line, --lab ndvi_basics -> --lab ndvi_landsat) is tracked for the E track (CROSS_TRACK CT-D1); until then the foundry flow passes against THIS file, not against the fixture authority. The fixture authority ndvi_basics.rules.json (128x128 EPSG:4326 committed scene, tests/fixtures/lab/ndvi_basics_reference.tif) stays untouched; two scenes, two authorities, no loosening.

NDVI=(N-R)/(N+R) is bounded by [-1,1] for non-negative reflectance (KNOWN_ANSWER_MATRIX spectral family). Catches display stretches (x100+50) and unit slips. Identical to the bundle overlay and the fixture authority — the physics does not depend on the scene.

Measured over the foundry seed-42 Lab scene (class map + reflectance table water/vegetation/urban/bare soil/forest/shadow with +/-0.02 portable noise, NDVI via safeDiv on float32 red/nir, nir=5/red=4 exactly as the lab-1 pipeline documents): full-scene mean ~0.4521261, population sigma ~0.5084647 with 131 denom-zero NaN pixels (131/65536 ~ 0.200%). Mean tolerance 0.01; sigma window [0.48, 0.54] absorbs float32 rounding across compilers. Calibration identical to the offline-classroom bundle overlay, which measured the same foundry output on Linux; the foundry determinism contract (identical emitted bytes per host+GDAL) plus these tolerances keep the pins portable.

The foundry landsat_sample declares no band NoData; rs:spectral_index writes NaN (declared NoData) where red+nir==0 after float32 noise — observed 131/65536 ~ 0.200%. min_ratio 0.001 catches a product that forgot to mask those pixels (ratio 0); max_ratio 0.05 catches over-masking. Identical to the bundle overlay.

The scene's dominant states (water/urban/soil vs vegetation/forest) put the NDVI histogram in two separated lobes; bimodality catches stretches that smear the classes. Identical to the bundle overlay.
